notes: AI daily reports analyze multiple available domains: plans, habits, mood, health, supplements, cycle and finances.
Finance transaction count no longer determines report priority; review can cover up to four evidence-backed life domains.
New report cards present cross-domain observations and measured next steps before technical evidence.
Keep previous reports intact and explicitly omit unsupported domains; new analysis takes effect on regeneration or next scheduled report.
Revisions require user confirmation before production deploy.
versionPolicy: Один пакет изменений = один production deploy. Сначала проверка и PR, затем подтверждение пользователя.
